title: Tiny, cute trophy
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d="M 28 40 Q 28 68 50 68 Q 72 68 72 40 L 68 38 Q 66 60 50 60 Q 34 60 32 38 Z" fill="#E8A020"/>

  <!-- Star on bowl -->
  <polygon points="50,46 52,51 57,51 53,54 55,59 50,56 45,59 47,54 43,51 48,51" fill="#FFF8DC"/>
  
  <!-- Shine -->
  <path d="M 36 44 Q 38 52 42 56" fill="none" stroke="#FFE680" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
